{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique values in 'arm' and 'responded'
print('Unique arms:', trial_df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique responses:', trial_df['responded'].unique())

# Check distribution of response by arm
response_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by arm:')
print(response_by_arm)

# Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_rate = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_rate = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

print(f'\nTreatment response rate: {treatment_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Control response rate: {control_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}')"}
